blind.description: A classic six-arm hanging chandelier designed in a stylized baroque fashion. It features a central turned brass/gold stem with a flat mounting disc at the top, six curved S-scroll arms extending outward each supporting a candle cup with an unlit cream-coloured candle and black wick, and faceted crystal teardrop prisms clustered underneath the central bowl.
blind.from_above: A radially symmetric six-pointed star or wheel layout, showing a central gold cap from which six arms radiate outwards at equal 60-degree intervals ending in round candle saucers, with faceted crystal drops peeking out below.
defects: intended as a hanging ceiling fixture but placed directly on the floor resting on the bottom crystal pendant
blind.height_vs_figure: About 40-45% as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2.5 ft tall) and roughly 2.5 to 3 ft in diameter.

notes: model rests on bottom crystal pendant as it lacks a ceiling mount
